summary: amazon.aws breaking changes in 10.0.0: dropped ansible-core below 2.15, iam_role/iam_role_info assume_role_policy_document no longer converted to snake_case, kms_key/kms_key_info return policies renamed to key_policies, and lambda_event batch_size no longer defaults to 100 (boto3 defaults to 10 for SQS and 100 for streams).
questions: Why did my kms_key policies return value disappear?
Why is assume_role_policy_document now in CamelCase?
What batch size does lambda_event use for SQS now?
Which ansible-core versions does amazon.aws support now?

answer_card.title: amazon.aws breaking changes in Ansible 10
answer_card.answer_md:
- Requires ansible-core 2.15+.
- `iam_role` / `iam_role_info`: `assume_role_policy_document` is no longer converted from CamelCase to snake_case.
- `kms_key` / `kms_key_info`: `policies` renamed to `key_policies` (same contents).
- `lambda_event`: `batch_size` no longer defaults to 100. The boto3 default applies, which is 10 for SQS and 100 for streams.
